title: Document Linux CARGO_TARGET_DIR override for rust/ builds
description: rust/.cargo/config.toml sets target-dir = /Volumes/Attic/Cache/Cargo (macOS Attic volume, root-drive protection). On Linux workers (e.g. lichen-workers worker boxes) that path does not exist and cargo fails with 'failed to create directory /Volumes/Attic/Cache: Permission denied'. The config comment already notes 'Env CARGO_TARGET_DIR overrides this if set'. Fix: record the working invocation in rust/AGENTS.md Build & Test section: CARGO_TARGET_DIR=/home/mark/Cache/cargo-target cargo test -p <crate> (matching ~/.cargo/config.toml's global target-dir), so Linux workers do not rediscover this. Docs-only change.
close_reason: Documented the Linux CARGO_TARGET_DIR override in rust/AGENTS.md Build & Test section, matching ~/.cargo/config.toml's global target-dir (/home/mark/Cache/cargo-target). Docs-only change (no source code touched, codereview passes not applicable). Discovered while working yiv0: first cargo invocation failed with 'failed to create directory /Volumes/Attic/Cache: Permission denied'.
